title: Messi sets World Cup scoring record as Argentina advances to knockout stage
summary: Lionel Messi scored twice, including a record-breaking 17th World Cup goal, to become the all-time leading goal-scorer in tournament history.

title: FIFA World Cup 2026 Round of 32 Bracket and Schedule: Road to the Final Takes Shape
summary: For the first time in the tournament’s history, 48 nations are chasing 32 knockout spots. Here is the complete bracket, schedule, and survival guide for Sri Lankan fans tracking the run to the Finals.

title: WhatsApp to be led by Indian start-up founder as Will Cathcart steps back
summary: WhatsApp boss Will Cathcart has announced that he is leaving his role.

title: US Assistant Secretary of State meets President Dissanayake
summary: United States Assistant Secretary of State for South and Central Asian Affairs Dr. Paul Kapur met President Anura Kumara Dissanayake at the Presidential Secretariat during his visit to Sri Lanka.

title: US Treasury eases sanctions, issues 60-day license for Iranian oil amid progress in peace talks
summary: In a major shift in Middle Eastern energy and security dynamics, the US Department of the Treasury on Monday issued a temporary 60-day general license authorising transactions related to the production, delivery, and sale of Iranian crude oil, petrochemicals, and petroleum products.

title: US provides Rs. 1.2 Billion satellite communications system to Sri Lanka Navy
summary: The United States today announced the provision of a Fleet Broadband satellite communications system worth approximately US$4 million (over Rs. 1.2 billion) to the Sri Lanka Navy, in a move aimed at strengthening maritime security and connectivity across the Indian Ocean.

title: Ex-Wimbledon champion Vondrousova given four-year ban
summary: Former Wimbledon champion Marketa Vondrousova has been banned for four years for refusing an anti-doping test last year.

title: Qatar says gas export terminal blast killed 13 as workers tried to resume operations
summary: An explosion tore through Qatar’s key natural gas export terminal Sunday night as workers tried to resume operations after Iran bombed it during the war , causing a fire that killed at least 13 people and hurt dozens more.

title: Three dead in Philippines high school shooting over bullying ’grudge’
summary: Three students have been killed and more injured after two of their peers opened fire at a high school in central Philippines, police say.

title: SC to hear appeal on Minister Wijepala’s parliamentary eligibility
summary: The Supreme Court today granted special leave to appeal against a Court of Appeal ruling that dismissed a challenge to the parliamentary eligibility of Minister of Public Security Ananda Wijepala.

title: Pushpika de Silva crown removal case: Verdict scheduled for September 14
summary: Colombo Chief Magistrate Asanga S. Bodaragama today fixed September 14 to deliver judgment in the case concerning the alleged forcible removal of the crown from Pushpika de Silva, the winner of the Mrs. Sri Lanka 2021 pageant, causing her injuries.

title: One dead, 10 injured in multi-vehicle crash in Kegalle
summary: A woman was killed and ten others were injured following a multi-vehicle accident in the Mangalagama area of Molagoda, Kegalle today (June 22).

title: Emotional Chamari takes blame for Sri Lanka loss at T20WC
summary: Sri Lanka captain Chamari Athapaththu believes she has let her side down and missed what could be her final chance to guide them to the knockout stages of the ICC Women’s T20 World Cup.

title: Delft, Nainativu and Analaitivu set for round-the-clock power
summary: Residents of Nainativu (Nagadeepa), Analaitivu and Delft islands will soon benefit from a 24-hour uninterrupted electricity supply through a new hybrid renewable energy system currently under construction, Energy Minister Anura Karunatilaka said during an inspection tour of the project.

title: PMD responds to Daily Mirror article on Sri Lanka Cricket
summary: The President’s Media Division (PMD) has issued a statement in response to today’s Daily Mirror article titled “Hold SLC Elections or Get Blacklisted, ICC Informs President AKD.”
